description: This PHP source file handles requirement test case assignment operations within the TestLink testing management system. It includes logic for assigning and unassigning requirements to test cases, bulk operations, and processing test suite and test case views, as well as handling user interactions and rendering templates.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: A generic PHP standard class used for creating simple objects to hold data.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Represents a test project, with methods for managing test suite information.

classes.name: requirement_spec_mgr
classes.description: Manages requirement specifications, including retrieval of requirement data.

classes.name: requirement_mgr
classes.description: Handles requirement data management, including assignments and bulk operations.

classes.name: testsuite
classes.description: Represents a test suite, with methods for retrieving test cases.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: Represents individual test cases with methods to retrieve tests and statuses.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Template engine class used for rendering HTML templates.

methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes input arguments from the request.

methods.description: Prepares and displays the test suite view and handles bulk assignment instructions.

methods.name: doBulkAssignment
methods.description: Performs bulk assignment of requirements to test cases.

methods.name: doSingleTestCaseOperation
methods.description: Performs assignment or unassignment of requirements to a single test case based on specified function.

methods.name: processTestCase
methods.description: Prepares and displays individual test case details, including assigned requirements.

methods.name: getTargetTestCases
methods.description: Retrieves the list of test case IDs associated with a test suite.

methods.description: Checks user permissions for managing requirement-test case links.
